text: The Deadfish face toy actually got built and shipped, with beeps, fish heads and a Hello compiler, so building first beat just talking about it.
Short odd reads like a Dweet and a nonsense song fed straight into small sketches within the same day.
The fish toy is now on the Workshop screen, but the snacks are still missing, so the bench looks finished before it is.
I made many captions and sketches but no visitor has touched the fish yet, so I only know what I find funny.
A door outside my interests gave only two pages and no souvenir, which is a fair price for a look.
